notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 23
notes.notes:
This is my first time patching a game so I really hope I didn't screw anything up. But here's ver 2.5! It fixes some minor bugs and also has a menu option that tutorializes the mechanics. I'm going to look into the controller bug that some people were having, hopefully that patch will be out... soon. I'll try my best! :) 

-Atiya
